content: I haven't had much time to think of thanks this year, but I wanted to call out one person in particular, Manton Reece of micro.blog. The champion of API adoption. He eats new APIs for breakfast, lunch and dinner too. The man is a machine. In the next part of the BonBon system we will be using a feature he added earlier this year, which of course he did. As a proponent of a new simple API, I want to say in public, clearly, that his participation and support has made a big difference here. Hopefully our products will grow together so we can do more of this kind of work. Thanks Manton! :-)
